updates.content:
Title: Some users may be unable to access Microsoft Viva Glint services

User impact: Users may be unable to access Viva Glint services.

More info: Affected users are able to log in as expected but may see a blank page and won't be able to access any Viva Glint services.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Viva Glint and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may be unable to access Microsoft Viva Glint services

User impact: Users may be unable to access Viva Glint services.

More info: Affected users are able to sign in as expected but may see a blank page and won't be able to access any Viva Glint services.

Current status: Our investigation determined that a recent build release contains a regression which is causing the impact. We're rolling this release back to remediate the issue.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to access Microsoft Viva Glint services may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Monday, August 24, 2026, at 5:20 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent build release contains a regression which is causing the impact.

Title: Some users may be unable to access Microsoft Viva Glint services

More info: Affected users were able to sign in as expected but may have seen a blank page and weren't able to access any Viva Glint services.

Final status: We've completed rolling back the offending build and after monitoring service health metrics, confirmed the impact is remediated.
